family: simple text formatting (padding, wrapping, title-casing, abbreviations, slugs)
spec: Join a list of numbers into a single comma-and-space-separated string of their decimal string representations, in order.
reference:
def format_list_of_numbers(nums):
    return ', '.join(str(n) for n in nums)

family: simple text formatting (padding, wrapping, title-casing, abbreviations, slugs)
spec: Join a list of lowercase words into a single camelCase string: the first word stays lowercase and every subsequent word is capitalized, with no separators. An empty list returns an empty string.

family: simple text formatting (padding, wrapping, title-casing, abbreviations, slugs)
spec: Join a list of lowercase words into a single PascalCase string by capitalizing each word and concatenating them with no separators. An empty list returns an empty string.
reference:
def pascal_case_join(words):
    return ''.join(w.capitalize() for w in words)

family: simple text formatting (padding, wrapping, title-casing, abbreviations, slugs)
spec: Join a list of words into a single snake_case string by lowercasing every word and joining them with underscores. An empty list returns an empty string.
reference:
def snake_case_join(words):
    return '_'.join(w.lower() for w in words)

family: simple text formatting (padding, wrapping, title-casing, abbreviations, slugs)
spec: Word-wrap a string of space-separated words into lines of at most width characters (without splitting words, joining words in a line with single spaces), then prefix every resulting line with the given number of leading spaces, and join the lines with newlines. Assume no single word is longer than width.
visible_tests: assert wrap_indent_block('the quick brown fox', 10, 2) == '  the quick\n  brown fox'
assert wrap_indent_block('one two three four', 7, 0) == 'one two\nthree\nfour'
hidden_tests: assert wrap_indent_block('a b c d e', 3, 1) == ' a b\n c d\n e'

assert wrap_indent_block('this is a longer sentence to wrap', 12, 2) == '  this is a
  longer
  sentence to
  wrap'
assert wrap_indent_block('aa bb cc dd ee ff', 5, 4) == '    aa bb\n    cc dd\n    ee ff'
assert wrap_indent_block('one two three', 100, 0) == 'one two three'

assert wrap_indent_block('a a a a a a a a', 3, 2) == '  a a
  a a
  a a
  a a'

assert wrap_indent_block('wrap this text please', 8, 5) == '     wrap
     this
     text
     please'
assert wrap_indent_block('multiple spaces here', 8, 1) == ' multiple\n spaces\n here'

assert wrap_indent_block('abc def ghi jkl', 6, 3) == '   abc
   def
   ghi
   jkl'
assert wrap_indent_block('padded text block', 6, 4) == '    padded\n    text\n    block'
